summary: Verified P1 data accuracy guards (confidence_score >= 85 floor on all 15 dashboard aggregation endpoints + clamped sold_count delta in _estimate_sales_from_snapshots) and confirmed My Products fix still works on 90D window. Both backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright + live UI) verified. 27/28 backend tests pass (1 skipped due to seed-data quirk).

minor.issue: The `search` parameter does not appear to match against the SKU field as an equality/substring filter. Searching for SKU '8595602569199' returned 10 unrelated products (with different SKUs) instead of either the exact match or an empty result. Likely a fuzzy name-match path that ignores the SKU column. Not a regression from this iteration, but worth fixing.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix /api/my-products `search` parameter to match SKU substring/exact — currently the param appears to silently route to a name-only fuzzy match, causing 'search=8595602569199' to return 10 unrelated SKUs instead of the expected match or empty result.

Pre-existing data-staleness note (not a code bug): The default 30-day window will appear sparse on My Products because competitor crawls last ran 36-70 days ago — use days=90 in UI/API for meaningful data. Consider surfacing a 'last crawl' timestamp banner in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: test_sales_estimator.py - clean, fast (0.01s), 6 focused unit tests with realistic edge cases (counter resets, spikes, daily cap, qty depletion fallback). Good coverage of the new Method-1 sum-of-clamped-deltas logic.
Confidence floor (>=85) is correctly applied across all 15 endpoints listed in the request. Spot-check of /api/my-products?days=90 matched-product subset confirms min confidence = 95.

Sold-count sanity: top store on 90D leaderboard = 49,875 units (~554/day total across many SKUs). Per-SKU top = 357 units / 90D = ~4/day. Both safely under the new clamps (MAX_SOLD_COUNT_DELTA_PER_INTERVAL=50 + MAX_DAILY_SALES_PER_SKU*days).
